sentences.en: MAN: And here on Radio Rivenden we have Lynne Rawley, the Public Relations Officer of our own Rivenden City Theatre.
sentences.zh: MAN: 接下来，里文登电台为您带来里文登市剧院的公关主管林恩·罗利女士。

sentences.en: Hello, Lynne.
sentences.zh: 你好，林恩。

sentences.en: LYNNE: Hello.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 你好。

sentences.en: MAN: Now, the theatre is reopening soon after its three-year redevelopment programme, isn't it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 剧院在历时三年的翻新改造工程后即将重新开放，是这样吗？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Testl 7. 3-10
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 试题7. 3-10

sentences.en: LYNNE: That's right, and there are a lot of improvements.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 没错，此次翻新带来了许多改进。

sentences.en: The first thing people will see when they go in is that the foyer has been repainted in the d9C.com original green and gold.
sentences.zh: 观众入场后首先看到的，是门厅已按原设计重新粉刷为绿色与金色。

sentences.en: Then the box office has been reoriented, with its own access from the side of the building instead of through the foyer, which means it can be open longer hours, and has more space, too.
sentences.zh: 接着，售票处已重新布局，增设了从建筑侧面直接进入的独立通道，不再需要经由门厅进出；这意味着售票处可延长营业时间，空间也更为宽敞。

sentences.en: The shop that used to be in the foyer, which sold books and CDs, is the one part of the redevelopment which isn't yet complete.
sentences.zh: 原先设在门厅内、出售图书和CD的商店，是本次翻新工程中唯一尚未完工的部分。

sentences.en: The plan is to find new premises for it near the theatre, and we've had difficulty finding somewhere suitable.
sentences.zh: 目前计划在剧院附近另寻新址开设该商店，但我们一直难以找到合适的场所。

sentences.en: We hope to reopen the shop in the next few months.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在接下来几个月内重新开放这家商店。

sentences.en: MAN: Will audiences find any difference in the auditorium?
sentences.zh: MAN: 观众在观众席会发现什么变化吗？

sentences.en: LYNNE: Yes, we've increased the leg-room between the rows.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 是的，我们增加了排与排之间的腿部空间。

sentences.en: This means that there are now fewer seats but we're sure audiences will be much happier.
sentences.zh: 因此，座位总数有所减少，但我们相信观众的观演体验将大幅提升。

sentences.en: And we've installed air conditioning, so it won't get so hot and stuffy.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们安装了空调系统，避免场内变得闷热难耐。

sentences.en: We already had a few seats which were suitable for wheelchair users, and now there are twice as many, which we hope will meet demand.
sentences.zh: 此前我们已有少量轮椅使用者专用座位，如今数量已增至原来的两倍，我们希望这能充分满足需求。

sentences.en: Something else that will benefit audiences is the new lifts.
sentences.zh: 另一项惠及观众的改进是全新电梯。

sentences.en: The two we used to have were very small and slow.
sentences.zh: 原先的两部电梯体积小、运行慢。

sentences.en: They've now gone, and we've got much more efficient ones.
sentences.zh: 它们已被全部更换，取而代之的是效率高得多的新电梯。

sentences.en: MAN: Anything for the performers?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么，演员方面有什么改进吗？

sentences.en: LYNNE: Yes, we've made a number of improvements backstage.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 是的，我们在后台区域进行了多项升级。

sentences.en: The small, dark dressing rooms we used to have have been converted into two large airy rooms, so they're much more comfortable now.
sentences.zh: 原先那些狭小昏暗的化妆间，现已改造成两间宽敞明亮的大房间，演员们的舒适度显著提升。

sentences.en: And the state- of-the-art electronic sound and lighting systems have been installed.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们还安装了最先进的电子音响与灯光系统。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, so what's the first play that audiences can see when the theatre reopens?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，那么剧院重新开放后，观众首场可观赏的剧目是什么呢？

sentences.en: LYNNE: We've got a very exciting production of Peter Shaffer's Royal Hunt of the Sun, which is currently touring the country.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 我们将隆重推出彼得·谢弗创作的《太阳神之猎》，该剧目前正在全国巡演，阵容十分令人期待。

sentences.en: That starts on October the 13th and runs till the 19th.
sentences.zh: 演出将于10月13日开始，持续至10月19日。

sentences.en: We're experimenting a bit with 017 the time the curtain goes up.
sentences.zh: 我们还在尝试调整开演时间。

sentences.en: We used to start all our performances at 7.30, but that made it difficult for people to go home by public transport, so instead we're beginning at 2, because at 9.45, when it finishes, there are still buses running.
sentences.zh: 过去所有演出均于晚上7:30开始，但这给观众搭乘公共交通返程带来困难；因此，我们将改为下午2点开演——因为演出于晚上9:45结束时，仍有公交车运营。

sentences.en: Tickets are already selling fast.
sentences.zh: 门票销售十分火爆。

sentences.en: The Friday and Saturday performances sold out almost immediately and, in fact, now there are only tickets for Monday and Thursday.
sentences.zh: 周五和周六的场次几乎瞬间售罄，事实上，目前仅剩周一和周四的余票。

sentences.en: MAN: How much are they?
sentences.zh: MAN: 票价是多少？

sentences.en: LYNNE: We've introduced a simpler price structure.
sentences.zh: LYNNE: 我们推出了更简化的票价体系。

sentences.en: Ticket prices used to range from £6 to £30 but now they're all £18.
sentences.zh: 过去票价范围为6英镑至30英镑，如今统一为18英镑。

sentences.en: They're available from the box office, in person, by phone, fax or post, or online.
sentences.zh: 门票可通过售票处现场购买、电话、传真、邮寄或在线方式订购。

sentences.en: MAN: OK, Lynne, now if you'd like to give the contact details for the theatre . . .
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，林恩，现在请您提供剧院的联系方式……
